DIAGNOSIS READY: Patellofemoral Pain Syndrome (Runner's Knee).

The negative X-ray rules out fractures and significant effusion, while the MRI guidance suggests avoiding advanced imaging for this initial presentation. Given your history of increased physical activity and the absence of structural damage, this clinical picture is most consistent with overuse of the patellofemoral joint.
